description: PowerShell cmdlet to enumerate and audit local user accounts, their status, SIDs, and password properties for security assessment.
prerequisites: Administrative privileges recommended for full visibility
LocalAccounts module available (default on modern Windows)

flags.purpose: Retrieve local users by exact name or wildcard pattern.
flags.outputs: User objects with Enabled, LastLogon, PasswordLastSet, SID.
flags.security_use_case: Audit built-in and suspiciously named accounts.
flags.threat_detected: Enabled Guest, rogue admin accounts, weak/empty password indicators.
flags.risk_if_misused: None (read-only). Wildcards may match unintended names.
flags.safe_followup: Disable, reset password, or remove unauthorized accounts after validation.

flags.purpose: Retrieve user by SID which remains constant even if account is renamed.
flags.outputs: Exact account mapped to well-known SID.
flags.security_use_case: Detect renamed built-in Administrator or Guest accounts.
flags.threat_detected: Renamed Administrator account used for stealth persistence.

powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Finds active accounts with old passwords indicating abandonment or compromise.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Dormant account persistence and credential theft risk.

powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Detects accounts violating password expiry policy, especially risky for admins/service accounts.
Enumerates built-in accounts even if renamed for stealth.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Built-in account abuse and privilege escalation detection.
